notes: PLACEHOLDER defaults for public beta. Runtime may override via env FEATURE_FLAGS_JSON or platform config. Owners must be humans/workstreams, not bots.

realtime_enabled.description: When false, API/routing must operate in schedule_only and label results accordingly.
realtime_enabled.safeDisable: Set false to stop consuming realtime; fall back to schedule_only. Prefer over serving unlabeled stale data.

constraints_enabled.description: When false, skip selected-line constraint ranking path; still return baseline itineraries.
constraints_enabled.safeDisable: Set false if constrained ranking misbehaves; baseline-only results remain available.

explanation_variant.safeDisable: Set to concise to reduce payload/UI risk; does not change ranking.

result_count.description: Max itineraries returned for constrained and baseline lists (API contract: at most 3 per list).
result_count.safeDisable: Lower toward 1 under load to protect latency SLOs (hard max remains 3).

maintenance_mode.description: When true, API returns typed unavailable / maintenance responses; web shows maintenance UI.
maintenance_mode.safeDisable: This flag IS the safe disable for the product surface — set true during incidents.

candidate_strategy.description: Selects candidate-generation strategy variant for experiments.
candidate_strategy.safeDisable: Set to default or baseline_only if experimental strategy regresses; keep ranking contract intact.
